notes.title: 5/4/2022 Hotfix 1
notes.notes: Fixed issues with enemies not responding.

notes.title: Beta Test Patch 1
notes.notes:
- Adjusted enemy placement.
- Adjusted lighting.
- Fixed issue with door not opening after all enemies were defeated.
- Added various sound queues.
- New enemy type will now spawn.
- Adjusted look of player's armor.

notes.title: Compliance Patch 2
notes.notes:
- Improved unarmed combat system.
- Updated Skytown intro cutscene
- Improved KB&M controls
- UV  light now corrrectly reveals hidden enemies
- Adjusted mimic enemy AI to respond to UV light
- Mimic enemies will now regen health when they are camouflaged
- Player health UI is now represented by lights on player's spine
- Player can now heal themselves overtime by crouching

notes.title: Compliance Patch 1
notes.notes:
Added gamepad support for all menus.
Reassigned keyboard inputs.
Added mod combat options for the twinblade weapon.
